e933de3ff57b3793.description: About the Role Air Products Qudra is seeking a Site Manager to oversee operations in Al Jubail. This full-time role involves managing a site team and a facility that includes an Air Separation Plant, Hydrogen Steam Methane Reformer, a CO2 unit, compression, a Steam Turbine Generator, and all associated ancillary and utility equipment, along with a merchant facility and pipeline network. The Site Manager reports to the Operation Line Manager and is responsible for supervising operations and maintenance staff. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day operations, including customer production meetings, to ensure daily operational targets are met. Interface with Maintenance and Engineering teams to ensure safe and reliable site operation. Provide leadership in company and industry safe work processes to prevent incidents and adhere to HSSE policies. Ensure compliance with all Environmental Regulatory requirements and BHIG standards for EH&S, productivity, reliability, quality, and customer services. Drive a risk-based decision culture to ensure effective safety control. Provide technical direction and guidance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and testing activities. Manage plant production efficiently based on data-driven decisions to achieve maximum profitability while meeting safety and reliability targets. Ensure the safety of all operations and maintenance personnel using BHIG’s Basic Safety Practice program. Facilitate planning, organizing, auditing, and follow-up to build the BHIG safety culture. Meet customer satisfaction targets for safety, reliability, product quality, and flexibility of product supply. Manage and organize regular equipment testing and routine preventive maintenance. Participate in preparing maintenance or process shutdowns and turnarounds. Provide coaching and motivation to the operations team to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Develop, train, and promote high-performing operation personnel. Lead incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis, identifying and implementing sustainable corrective actions. Act as the Single Point of Contact for internal facility issues, representing BHIG and coordinating internal resources. Team Management and Development The Site Manager will directly manage and supervise operations and maintenance staff, including the Assistant Site Manager, Shift Supervisors, Operators, and the maintenance team. This involves fostering a site culture that promotes teamwork and a high-performing organization, ensuring personnel are customer and employee-focused, foster open communication, and are performance-driven and results-oriented. Operational and Technical Support This role provides essential operations and maintenance support, maintaining accurate document control, and monitoring quality assurance initiatives. The Site Manager will ensure safety, reliability, and maintainability of equipment, processes, utilities, facilities, controls, and safety/security systems. This includes providing input for scheduled outages to meet contractual requirements and working closely with business areas to identify productivity expansion projects. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to manage complex industrial facilities and diverse teams. Proficiency in utilizing safety programs such as Safety Work Permits, LOTO, and Confined Space procedures. Experience with SAP notifications for maintenance activities. Skills in conducting risk assessments for operational and maintenance activities. Ability to build plant technical capability through coordination with Regional and Global teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail. The role requires establishing and maintaining close working relationships with engineering and maintenance personnel to continuously monitor and evaluate plant systems and equipment.

e9a06905e6047b6f.description: About the Role The برنامج خلك مسيطر program is seeking to expand its team of Saudi professional coaches and consultants. This Career Coach role is offered on a remote basis, with options for full-time or part-time engagement. We are looking for professionals with practical experience in the Saudi labor market and a commitment to helping individuals develop their careers, enhance their professional presence, and achieve their goals through practical guidance and training. Role Philosophy We believe that the coach's role is not to perform tasks on behalf of the beneficiary, but rather to empower them to acquire the necessary skills and strategies to develop their career path independently. The ideal candidate will guide beneficiaries in mastering career development techniques. Key Responsibilities Provide weekly individual coaching sessions to beneficiaries remotely. Assess beneficiaries' professional status and assist them in defining goals and developing practical action plans. Guide beneficiaries in improving their CVs and LinkedIn profiles. Train beneficiaries on job search strategies and identifying suitable companies and opportunities. Develop professional communication and networking skills. Prepare beneficiaries for job interviews and conduct mock interviews. Provide guidance on salary negotiation, promotions, and career transitions. Monitor beneficiary progress and provide practical feedback and recommendations. Document sessions and follow-up notes, coordinating with the client success and operations team. Adhere to session schedules and quality standards adopted by the program. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi nationality is required. 5-10 years of practical experience in Human Resources, Recruitment and Talent Acquisition, or Career Consulting and Development. Strong knowledge of the Saudi labor market, employment requirements, and career paths. Ability to deliver professional individual consulting and training sessions. Familiarity with strategies for improving CVs and professional presence on LinkedIn. Skills in job interview preparation, career guidance, and effective communication. Ability to work with beneficiaries from diverse sectors and professional levels. High-level skills in listening, analysis, and providing constructive feedback. Commitment, follow-up, and professional handling of remote work tools. Work Arrangement Location: Remote, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Work Type: Full-time (40 hours/week) or Part-time (30 hours/week). Work details and financial compensation will be determined during the hiring process based on experience and work type. Application Process If you possess the experience and passion to empower professionals in developing their careers, we invite you to apply and join the برنامج خلك مسيطر team. Applications will be reviewed, and suitable candidates will be contacted for the next stage.

e94339f34f60dde2.description: Building on our past. Ready for the future Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now. Primary Objective Designs, assigns, supervises, and schedules Ports & Marine Engineering activities for Marine projects. Technical and business management of all ports & marine engineering elements of projects executed. Management of all marine structural engineers within, and technical and career development mentoring of all ports and marine structures engineers within. Preparation of strategic, marketing and business development plans for the positioning and winning of Ports and Marine Structures business across Africa, or elsewhere as opportunities arise. Responsibility for the commercial and technical execution and delivery of regional Marine Structures projects, including annual budgeting and profitability. Preparation of feasibility and design criteria reports for marine structures engineering works such as quaywalls, jetties, breakwaters, etc. Identify technology development and training requirements, including participation at international conferences. Co-operate with the Port Planning and Marine Structures Teams globally and other project groups and personnel to set and monitor strategic objectives regarding technologies, in particular coastal modelling software and data sources. Input to coaching, teaching, mentoring and effective supervision of assigned personnel. Ensures communication flow, both verbal and written, is maintained within the Ports & Marine Structural Engineering group and with other engineering disciplines. Assists with the upkeep of storage and listing of all Ports & Marine Structural Engineering specific standards stored on the computer network. Coordinates Ports & Marine Structural Engineering design activities with other design and engineering groups. Represents the Marine Structural Engineering area in meetings with suppliers, subcontractors, licensors, clients, and other Company disciplines, and produces documentation required for conference or meeting notes. Prepare marketing material and building client relationships. Business travel as required. Essential Skills/Experience 20 years plus relevant experience in all facets of maritime engineering, all design stages (Pre Feed, Feed, and detailed design), including design of marine terminals and structures. Experience in port planning and operations is desirable. Significant experience in design of Intake, outfall, berths, approach trestles, Dolphins, jetties and quay walls. Experience in piling is essential. Dredging & reclamation experience would be an asset. Experience with various maritime and structural engineering-related software tools. Expert knowledge of maritime design standards including BS, Eurocodes, ACI, PIANC, ASCE. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in preparing proposals and delivering presentations. Strong management skills, particularly as regards large and/or complex projects related to marine. Team leadership and junior engineer/designer mentoring and coaching experience. Extensive experience with: Microsoft Office products, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Experience with MS Project and/or other scheduling products. Financial management of projects and resources, including budgeting. Matching Indicators A degree in Civil or Structural Engineering or Maritime Engineering, and is registered or be eligible for registration with professional engineering association(s). A Masters degree in Maritime Engineering is desirable. Moving forward together We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law. We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

e907f808336430a5.company_name: فرع شركة سالم صالح بابقي التجارية
e907f808336430a5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نسيج العالمية التجارية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية اليومية، بما في ذلك إعداد المستندات المحاسبية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل القيود، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد القيود المالية. القدرة على تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التسويات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير والوثائق. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. الالتزام بتطوير الأساليب والإجراءات المحاسبية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التجارية للشركة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

e90d0f75aa9bdce5.job_title: Microsoft Dynamics F&O Functional Consultant Supply Chain
e90d0f75aa9bdce5.description: About the Role Saleh Al-Rajhi & Partners Co. Ltd is seeking a Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Functional Consultant – Supply Chain to join their team in Riyadh, Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves leading, analyzing, designing, and supporting supply chain business processes within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (SCM). The consultant will ensure successful implementation, testing, data migration, user adoption, and continuous improvement across the organization, acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and implementation partners to deliver effective and scalable ERP solutions. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Business Analysis and Solution Design Lead supply chain requirements workshops with stakeholders across procurement, warehouse, operations, finance, and IT departments. Gather, document, and analyze business requirements. Conduct process mapping and fit-gap analysis to identify system and business process improvements. Prepare Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTMs). Ensure business requirements are translated into effective system solutions. Dynamics 365 SCM Configuration and Support Configure, support, and optimize Dynamics 365 SCM modules including Procurement & Sourcing, Sales Orders, Inventory Management, Warehouse Management, Master Planning, and Product Information Management (PIM). Design and maintain product, vendor, and inventory master data across multiple legal entities. Provide functional expertise and recommendations on system best practices. Solution Validation and Quality Assurance Review implementation partner deliverables and ensure compliance with approved business requirements. Provide objective assessments and recommendations for solution acceptance and sign-off. Support project governance, risk management, and quality assurance activities. Develop and execute end-to-end testing scenarios covering the full supply chain process lifecycle. Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing activities. Track, manage, and resolve functional defects through closure. Ensure solutions meet business objectives and operational requirements. Data Migration, Integrations, and Training Support vendor, inventory, and master data migration activities. Validate opening balances and data quality. Coordinate functional aspects of integrations with barcode systems, warehouse devices, and third-party applications. Assist in data validation and reconciliation activities. Develop user guides, training materials, and standard operating procedures. Conduct training sessions for key users and end users. Support go-live planning and execution. Provide hypercare support and post-implementation assistance. Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities within supply chain processes. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience relevant to the responsibilities outlined above. Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

e95e5810f8b2b7ac.description: About the Role Brainlake is seeking a highly technical Solution Architect specializing in Microsoft Dynamics CRM to lead the design and delivery of enterprise customer engagement platforms. This is a hands-on, client-facing contract role based in Makkah, with work in Jeddah and Makkah, requiring a professional who is comfortable engaging with stakeholders and conducting technical design reviews. The successful candidate will shape target architectures across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform and guide delivery teams to scalable solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead discovery sessions with business and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, current processes, and customer engagement requirements. Define end-to-end target architectures across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Customer Insights (Data and Journeys). Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, balancing configuration, low-code, and custom development. Document key architectural decisions, including fit-gap analysis, out-of-the-box vs. custom approaches, environment strategy, data model design, and security model. Design the Dataverse data model, security architecture (business units, security roles, teams, field-level security), and data migration approach from legacy CRM systems. Design integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise platforms such as ERP (including Finance & Operations), marketing, telephony, identity, and data platforms, utilizing Azure Integration Services, APIs, and event-driven patterns. Define the solution approach across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Copilot Studio. Provide technical leadership to development teams, including design and code reviews for plugins, PCF controls, and custom workflows, development standards, and ALM through Azure DevOps or Power Platform Pipelines. Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency where applicable. Contribute to solutioning, estimation, and scoping of new phases and change requests. Prototype and validate approaches before full implementation to reduce delivery risk. Identify opportunities to use Copilot and AI capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform to create business value. Advise clients on platform roadmap, licensing implications, and adoption best practices. Produce high-quality architecture artifacts, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, and technical decision records. Collaborate with functional consultants, data, integration, and delivery leads throughout discovery, design, build, and optimization phases. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of experience in enterprise technology, including 6+ years architecting on Dynamics 365 CE / CRM. Proven track record of leading end-to-end Dynamics 365 implementations on large-scale, multi-workstream programs. Experience in a consulting or systems integration environment, delivering for enterprise clients within a structured, client-facing delivery model. Deep hands-on expertise in Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, including data modeling, security model, business process flows, plugins, and the Web API. Strong working knowledge of the Power Platform and its governance, including environments, DLP policies, and the Center of Excellence (CoE) approach. Solid integration and Azure skills, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, and Azure Synapse Link / Microsoft Fabric. Experience leading data migration from legacy CRM platforms (*, older Dynamics versions or Salesforce). Ability to communicate architecture clearly to both senior business stakeholders and technical teams. Comfort working independently in a contract capacity and quickly becoming productive within established client teams. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 functional certifications. Experience with Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Omnichannel, or Field Service at scale. Experience in regulated or public-sector environments, such as financial services, government, or telecoms. e962a721c5d9ca1c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية للتسويق أسواق المزرعة عن موظف صندوق محاسبة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يضطلع شاغل هذه الوظيفة بمسؤولية إدارة المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية، وضمان دقة سجلات المبيعات، وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى موظف الصندوق المحاسبي مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير العمليات المالية بسلاسة ودقة، وتشمل ما يلي: عدّ وتسجيل المبالغ المالية في آلة تسجيل النقود في بداية كل وردية عمل، مع التأكد من توفر كمية كافية من العملات الصغيرة. استلام المدفوعات من العملاء نقداً أو عن طريق بطاقات الائتمان أو أي طرق دفع أخرى معتمدة، ودفع المبالغ المتبقية، وتحرير الإيصالات اللازمة. تحديث قوائم الأسعار بشكل مستمر، وحساب أسعار السلع أو الخدمات، وإعداد جداول الفواتير، وتطبيق الخصومات عند اللزوم. تسوية النقدية الواردة مع إجمالي المبيعات في نهاية الوردية، والإبلاغ عن أي اختلافات أو تسويتها وفقاً للإجراءات المتبعة. التعامل مع العملاء بأسلوب مهني وودود، وتلبية طلباتهم المتعلقة بإضافة أو حذف عناصر من قوائم الشراء. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع المعاملات النقدية والائتمانية بدقة. مهارات جيدة في خدمة العملاء والتواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الصندوق المحاسبي ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية في أسواق المزرعة بمدينة الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية، وهو دور يتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والزملاء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور للانضمام إلى فريق الشركة السعودية للتسويق أسواق المزرعة.

e97225cfa7bb6cbc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الطائف، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات التوزيع لأنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة تنفيذها. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة قوية ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الطائف، مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة سراكو. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالمعايير المهنية العالية والعمل ضمن بيئة ديناميكية. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. المدينة: الطائف. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الميكانيكيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى التقديم.

e903ceec179a0f1f.description: Title: AI Cybersecurity Risk Senior Manager Division: Cybersecurity Location: Riyadh Working Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Sunday to Thursday) Role: Cybersecurity Risk Management to support in managing the enterprise-wide cybersecurity risk management program. e9a783fdc30afbbd.description: Be the change. Join the world’s most visionary developer. Lead cross-departmental coordination to ensure alignment of crisis response procedures with brand positioning and RSG values. Organize workshops, simulations, and media training, including specialized crisis media training for executives and spokespeople. Prepare crisis communication materials, including holding statements, press releases, FAQs, and social media content. Oversee project planning, resourcing, timelines, and reporting for crisis preparedness initiatives. Manager Risk and crisis communications Coordinate with RSG’s Risk, Legal, Operations, and Corporate Affairs teams to ensure integrated planning and response. e92f8a5a6db66c66.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Human Resources Manager to lead and oversee the full spectrum of HR functions in Saudi Arabia. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across all areas of human resources, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, payroll, HR policies, and organizational development. The HR Manager will play a key role in developing and implementing effective HR strategies, ensuring compliance with Saudi labor laws and regulations, strengthening employee engagement, and aligning HR practices with the organization's business objectives. This role requires a hands-on professional with strong leadership, strategic thinking, and operational capabilities who can manage day-to-day HR activities while driving continuous improvement across the organization. Key Responsibilities 1. Talent Acquisition and Recruitment Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including workforce planning, job postings, candidate sourcing, interviewing, selection, and offer negotiation. Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract, hire, and retain high-quality talent. Partner with department heads to identify staffing needs and ensure timely fulfillment of vacancies. Oversee onboarding, orientation, and integration programs for new employees. 2. HR Operations and Administration Oversee all HR operations, including employee records, employment contracts, HR documentation, personnel files, and employee lifecycle management. Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and internal guidelines in line with business requirements and applicable regulations. Ensure the accuracy, confidentiality, and proper maintenance of employee data and HR systems. Streamline HR processes to improve operational efficiency and service delivery. 3. Payroll, Compensation and Benefits Manage and oversee monthly payroll processing, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and timely salary disbursement. Administer employee compensation, benefits, allowances, leave entitlements, and other employment-related payments. Coordinate with Finance to ensure accurate payroll reconciliation, budgeting, and reporting. Review compensation structures and benefits programs to support employee retention and market competitiveness. 4. Saudi Labor Law and Regulatory Compliance Ensure compliance with Saudi Labor Law and applicable employment regulations, including relevant requirements of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development (MHRSD). Oversee HR-related government processes and platforms, including Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, and other applicable systems. Monitor employment contracts, work permits, residency documentation, Saudization requirements, and other regulatory obligations, as applicable. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of changes in Saudi labor regulations and implement necessary policy and process updates. Manage HR audits, documentation, and compliance reporting to minimize legal and operational risks. 7. Strategic HR Planning and Management Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the organization's business goals and growth plans. Advise senior management on workforce planning, organizational structure, employee productivity, and people-related challenges. Establish and monitor HR key performance indicators (KPIs), including recruitment timelines, turnover, retention, absenteeism, and employee engagement. Prepare HR reports, headcount analysis, and workforce forecasts to support informed management decisions. Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance HR effectiveness and organizational performance. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 5–8 years of progressive HR experience , with proven experience in a managerial or senior HR role. Strong, hands-on knowledge of the full HR lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compensation and benefits, employee relations, performance management, and HR administration. Demonstrated experience developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and strategic initiatives. Solid knowledge of Saudi Labor Law, employment regulations, and relevant government HR systems. Proven ability to lead recruitment activities, improve talent acquisition strategies, and support workforce planning. Experience managing payroll, employee benefits, HR documentation, and employee records with a high degree of accuracy and confidentiality. Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and advise managers and employees on HR policies, performance management, and employee relations. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. Preferred Competencies Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach to HR management. Strong decision-making skills and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters professionally. Ability to work effectively with senior management, department heads, and employees at all levels. A proactive mindset with a focus on process improvement, compliance, and employee experience. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment. Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Position: Full-Time | HR Manager

e9722dd74033e5ba.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن إطفائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الوقاية من الحرائق ومكافحتها، وحماية الأرواح والممتلكات، بالإضافة إلى القيام بجهود الإنقاذ اللازمة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الاستجابة الفورية لإنذارات الحرائق ومكالمات الطوارئ بأقصى سرعة وفعالية. تقييم ظروف الحرائق وإطفائها باستخدام المعدات والأجهزة المتخصصة مثل عربات الإطفاء، ومضخات وخراطيم المياه. تحديد أماكن الضحايا وإخلائهم من المباني المحترقة ومواقع الحوادث، وتقديم الإسعافات الأولية عند الضرورة. تفتيش مواقع الحرائق بعد إخماد النيران لمنع انتشار المواد الخطرة أو الحد من تأثيرها. المشاركة في حملات توعية الجمهور حول كيفية الوقاية من الحرائق وأساليب حماية الأرواح والممتلكات. إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية ورفعها إلى المسؤول المختص. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإطفاء ومكافحة الحرائق. القدرة على استخدام معدات الإطفاء والإنقاذ بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والوقاية من الحرائق. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وفي ظروف الطوارئ. بيئة العمل تتطلب هذه الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. سيعمل الإطفائي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى ضمان السلامة العامة وحماية الأرواح والممتلكات. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة.

e928faa4bd40c500.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الهفوف. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على التنفيذ لضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع والتأكد من مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، مع توضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على فهم وتحليل المخططات الهندسية والتقارير الفنية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في المشاريع الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الهفوف بالمنطقة الشرقية. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

e9908c60f888282c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمر عبدالوهاب البدران عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وصيانة المعدات والأنظمة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر، ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال وصيانة المعدات الكهربائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستتاح الفرصة للمهندس الكهربائي للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع متنوعة. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الكهربائيين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

e9928a882215c57c.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers over one billion times a day across more than 200 countries and territories. In 2021, PepsiCo generated over $79 billion in net revenue, driven by a portfolio that includes brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. The company's vision is to achieve global leadership by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation that integrates sustainability and human capital into its value creation and growth model. The Merchandiser Role This full-time Merchandiser position is an integral part of the sales team, focusing on maximizing PepsiCo's on-shelf presence in all assigned outlets. The role involves ensuring adherence to planograms for both on-shelf and off-shelf displays and reporting any non-compliance. Additionally, the Merchandiser will gather and report market information to the pre-seller to identify selling opportunities. This role requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Call on specific OT outlets according to the daily journey plan provided by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products within OT stores across various access points, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point of Sale (POS) material next to SSFL displays where applicable. Ensure all access points are merchandised in accordance with approved planograms. Rotate products using the First-In, First-Out (FIFO) method and remove sub-standard products. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Provide daily activity reports for the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling and redemption campaigns as required. Maintain appropriate personal appearance and professional behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Additional Duties Conduct in-store sampling sessions and in-store sampling and/or promotions when required. Report any non-compliance with agreed arrangements to the pre-seller immediately. Supply the pre-seller with the latest market information to capitalize on selling opportunities. Candidate Profile We are seeking a candidate with 0-1 years of experience who is prepared to contribute to our sales team. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a commitment to maintaining high merchandising standards and effective communication. Work Environment At PepsiCo, employees drive our culture, which is dynamic and collaborative. We foster a diverse workforce by creating an equitable and inclusive space where everyone has a voice. The company is committed to creating a space for individuals to be themselves.

e99469c8e6d23418.description: About KEO Group KEO Group is an AEP/PMCM firm recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. The Opportunity KEO Group is seeking a Senior Sustainability Engineer (Green Certification) to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading sustainability consultancy projects and green building certification processes. The Senior Sustainability Engineer will support clients and project teams in achieving their sustainability objectives and targeted green certification ratings. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage sustainability consultancy and green building certification projects from pre-concept to completion of design stages. Manage green building certification processes, including LEED, Mostadam, WELL, and other relevant rating systems, ensuring compliance with applicable sustainability requirements and targeted certification ratings. e9ee48ca777d4030.description: About the Role Air Arabia is seeking a Captain A320 to join their team in Dammam. This is a full-time position for an experienced pilot with over 10 years of experience. The Captain is responsible for conducting assigned flights in accordance with the Airline Operational Manual and civil aviation authority regulations, ensuring ultimate safety, security, and efficiency. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to ensure the safe, secure, and efficient operation of all assigned flights. The Captain will support and guide the flight and cabin crew, effectively manage emergencies and ad-hoc scenarios, and maintain control of the flight to ensure successful performance and uphold the corporate image. Key Responsibilities Operate assigned aircraft according to schedules and approved flight plans, bearing ultimate responsibility for the aircraft during flights, prioritizing safety, efficiency, and passenger comfort. Ensure all assigned flights adhere to the Airline’s Operations Manual and relevant regulations, continuously implementing and monitoring procedures for safe and smooth aircraft operation. Verify timely attendance, proper grooming, fitness, and legal compliance for self and flight crew, conducting pre-flight briefings and ensuring continuous briefing as per adopted procedures. Liaise with co-pilots and the Dispatch Team before each flight to ensure flight and cabin crew are prepared with necessary information, including aircraft technical status, route preferences, weather, fuel, and role distribution. Ensure efficient and effective fuel usage during flight, within the safety constraints detailed in the Airline’s Operations Manual. Oversee required safety, security, fuel, and transit checks by assigned flight and cabin crew before, during, and after each flight, directing crew actions during irregularities and escalating issues as needed. Collaborate with Maintenance Engineers to confirm aircraft technical status and suitability for flight, seeking support from MCC and MROs for concerns or defects, and implementing immediate rectification where applicable. Ensure all necessary documents and technical logs are accurately loaded with data as per Airline and civil aviation authority regulations, including the technical logbook, journey book, and boarding sheets. Ensure the Airline Operations Manual is distributed, accounted for, maintained, kept up-to-date, understood, and complied with by Flight Crew. Stay current with legal requirements from regulatory bodies such as the civil aviation authority, Airbus Company, and other relevant bodies pertaining to flights and Flight Crew. Undertake additional ground-based tasks, such as Safety Officer or Security Officer, as directed by the line manager and in accordance with Part A of the Airline’s Operations Manual. Required Experience and Skills Acceptable industry knowledge in aircraft systems and operating procedures. Knowledge and exposure to handle delegated roles such as security or safety, as required by Airline and civil aviation authority regulations. Exposure to QA/Safety/Security/Audit procedures and practices affecting Flight Operations. Capability to implement policies, procedures, and manuals according to approved standards and regulations. Ability to perform effectively in a changing environment with heavy workloads and ad-hoc scenarios. Composed, self-confident, and focused, capable of handling emergencies and threats efficiently. Proven skills in analyzing data, identifying pitfalls, and recommending cost-effective solutions. Cost-oriented with effective problem-solving and decision-making skills. High accuracy and attention to both results and details. Ability to employ technical expertise and interpersonal relations to support company objectives. Demonstrated ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, requiring a professional who can manage demanding schedules and dynamic operational environments. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

e97ee4ea8abf5b82.description: About Lucidya: Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. e97942870fdc488f.description: ‏⁦ Job Title: Materials / Concrete Quality Engineer (Materials / Quality Engineer) Location: Based on company project locations, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Job Type: Full-time (Field / Concrete Lab) Job Purpose: We are looking for a highly competent concrete materials engineer with a strong passion for work and performance development to join our team. You will be primarily responsible for efficiently designing concrete mixes and ensuring their compliance with specifications, with a primary focus on improving production quality, reducing raw material waste, and increasing operational cost efficiency, in addition to representing the company and gaining the trust of project consultants on site. This role requires full flexibility in mobility and working additional flexible hours according to project requirements. Key Duties and Responsibilities: Design and Development of Concrete Mixes (Mix Design): Preparing and developing standard and special concrete mix designs based on project requirements and approved specifications. Dealing with Site Consultants: Discussing and approving concrete mixes with consultant engineers on site, and managing and resolving any technical feedback or discussions with professionalism and confidence. Implementing Quality Systems: Supervising the plant laboratory, and conducting periodic testing of raw materials (aggregates, sand, cement, chemical admixtures) and fresh and hardened concrete to ensure compliance with (ASTM / ACI / SASO). Cost Management and Waste Reduction: Analyzing material ratios in mixes to achieve maximum efficiency and the lowest possible cost without compromising quality, and working to reduce raw material waste during production and transport. Technical Production Monitoring and Problem Solving: Monitoring batch weighing accuracy, controlling temperatures, addressing any concrete defects, and offering immediate, convincing engineering solutions to the consultant and site. Field Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work across various company project sites and laboratories within the Kingdom, and covering overtime hours as required by site needs and concrete pours. Qualifications and Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering , Materials Engineering , or a related discipline. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Materials Engineer in ready-mix concrete plants (Ready Mix). Full Flexibility and Readiness: Complete readiness to relocate and travel between various company project locations, and willingness to work overtime during peak workloads or night and continuous pours. Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skills and a high ability to interact positively and address feedback from project consultants on site. Passion and Self-Motivation: Genuine desire for field work, high productivity, and handling work pressure with positive energy and ambition to grow. Thorough knowledge of American Society for Testing and Materials ( ASTM ), American Concrete Institute ( ACI ), and Saudi Standards ( SASO ). Proven skill in Value Engineering , cost optimization, and waste reduction. Valid and Mandatory Membership in the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). Job Title: Concrete Materials & Quality Engineer Location: Based on Company Project Locations, Saudi Arabia Job Type: Full-time (On-site / Concrete Lab) Job Purpose: We are seeking a highly skilled, passionate, and driven Concrete Materials Engineer to join our Ready-Mix team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing concrete mix designs, maintaining strict quality control systems, optimizing costs, and effectively managing technical relationships with on-site consultants. This role demands high mobility across various project sites and the willingness to support extended work hours based on project milestones. Key Responsibilities: Consultant Management & Collaboration: Act as the primary technical point of contact for project consultants on-site, managing mix design approvals, addressing technical inquiries, and confidently resolving any quality concerns. Concrete Mix Design: Design, test, and optimize standard and specialized concrete mixes to meet project specifications and structural requirements. Quality Assurance & Control: Oversee laboratory operations, conduct routine testing on raw materials (aggregates, cement, water, admixtures) and concrete in compliance with ASTM, ACI, and SASO standards. Cost Optimization & Waste Reduction: Analyze mix designs to implement cost-effective formulations, minimize material wastage during batching, and maximize resource efficiency. Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate and resolve concrete-related issues and provide immediate engineering solutions acceptable to project consultants. Site Flexibility: Relocate or travel between different company project sites and concrete labs as needed, and manage site laboratory tasks during extended casting shifts. Qualifications & Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering , Materials Engineering , or a related technical field. Minimum of 5 years of proven experience as a Materials/QC Engineer strictly within the Ready-Mix Concrete industry. Mobility & Overtime Availability: Full readiness to relocate/travel to different project locations across Saudi Arabia, and complete flexibility to work overtime hours (including night shifts or extended casting operations) when required. Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills with a proven track record of handling site consultants professionally. High energy and passion: Must possess a strong work ethic, a proactive mindset, and a genuine enthusiasm for engineering excellence. Deep knowledge of ACI, ASTM, and SASO concrete standards. Strong background in cost control, value engineering, and waste management . Valid and active membership with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) is mandatory.

e99ffc53847271d8.description: About International Maritime Industries International Maritime Industries is seeking a Specialist, Contracting to join their team. e9a370575f6a5c0e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب وتشغيل أجهزة المختبر الكيميائي، وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية، وإجراء التجارب الكيميائية وفقًا للمعايير المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة ويعتبر فرصة للمتخصصين في هذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب أجهزة المختبر الكيميائي وفقًا للمخطط التوزيعي المعتمد، وتشغيلها بحسب تعليمات المشرف الكيميائي والشركة المصنعة. دراسة التجربة الكيميائية المطلوبة وتحديد ظروف وشروط ومستلزمات إجرائها بالتنسيق مع الكيميائي. إجراء التجارب الكيميائية وفقًا للمعايير المعتمدة وبحسب تعليمات الكيميائي، مع استخراج النتائج وتسجيلها وتوثيقها. تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية لأجهزة المختبر الكيميائي بحسب تعليمات الشركة المصنعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير التجارب الكيميائية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. يجب أن يكون المرشح قادرًا على فهم وتنفيذ التعليمات الفنية بدقة والعمل ضمن بيئة مختبرية منظمة. بيئة العمل يعمل فني الكيمياء بدوام كامل في مختبرات الشركة بالمدينة المنورة. تتطلب بيئة العمل الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة والجودة والتعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة. نطاق المسؤوليات يشمل نطاق المسؤوليات تركيب وتشغيل وصيانة الأجهزة الكيميائية، بالإضافة إلى إجراء التجارب الكيميائية وإعداد تقارير مفصلة عنها. يساهم هذا الدور بشكل مباشر في دعم العمليات المخبرية وضمان دقة النتائج. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في الوقت الحالي.

e96ebaafe050197e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة شمعة التوحد للتأهيل عن أخصائي نفسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على البحث في أوجه النشاط النفسي البشري وتفسير السلوك الفردي، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال علم النفس. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة جميع مظاهر الحياة النفسية من خلال تحليل جوانب السلوك المختلفة مثل السلوك الحركي والعقلي والانفعالي والاجتماعي. فهم وتطبيق مبادئ التعلم لحالات التعلم الإنساني وأشكاله المتعددة. إجراء دراسات ميدانية لتطبيق اختبارات الذكاء والأداء بهدف قياس أنماط النمو العقلي والنفسي. دراسة المبادئ والقوانين العامة لاستخلاص الأسس المميزة للسلوك الإنساني. تحليل وتطوير الاتجاهات والقيم الاجتماعية بناءً على المعلومات المستنبطة من المراقبة والمتابعة أو البحوث والتجارب الميدانية. دراسة وتطوير النظريات والاستخدامات التطبيقية في مجال تعديل السلوك. دراسة الأسس البيولوجية للسلوك من خلال التعرف على أجزاء الجهاز العصبي وتأثيرها على السلوك. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بعلم النفس، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال علم النفس أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إجراء البحوث وتحليل البيانات النفسية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية، ضمن فريق عمل شركة شمعة التوحد للتأهيل. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

e99b164e59d47926.description: About the Role Kerten Hospitality is seeking an F&B Manager for The House Hotel Jeddah King Road. This full-time role involves leading Food & Beverage operations, ensuring service excellence, and managing staff to deliver guest experiences. The position is based in Jeddah and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. About Kerten Hospitality and The House Hotel Jeddah Kerten Hospitality (KH) operates as an end-to-end lifestyle hospitality provider, focusing on creating bespoke destinations, lodging, experiences, and communities. The company prioritizes optimizing operations and driving profitability for investors, with a commitment to sustainability and ESG principles. KH develops destinations through partnerships across Lodging, Food & Beverage, Retail, Entertainment, Art, and Wellness brands, aiming to build ecosystems and community-centric destinations. The House Hotel Jeddah, located on the Red Sea coastline, offers 129 rooms and a signature restaurant, serving as a contemporary urban escape in Jeddah, a city known for its coastal lifestyle, culture, and modern life. Key Responsibilities Oversee and manage all food and beverage operations across outlets, ensuring high service standards, consistency, and guest satisfaction. Lead day-to-day operations of restaurants, bars, and events, ensuring smooth service flow and operational efficiency. Develop and implement menus, concepts, and service standards in collaboration with the Executive Chef and hotel leadership. Monitor food and beverage costs, labor productivity, and inventory levels to achieve budgeted targets and maximize profitability. Prepare operational reports, forecasts, and performance analyses, identifying opportunities for improvement. Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and food safety regulations at all times. Recruit, train, schedule, and motivate the F&B team, fostering a positive culture of teamwork and continuous development. Coordinate with suppliers and vendors, managing procurement, quality standards, and cost control. Support pre-opening activities, including outlet setup, SOP development, team training, and soft-opening execution. Collaborate closely with Rooms, Sales & Marketing, and Finance teams to enhance the overall guest experience. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in Food & Beverage management. Demonstrated ability to lead operations and ensure high service standards. Experience in menu development, cost control, and team management. Benefits of Joining Competitive Compensation: A compensation package based on experience. Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement within the organization. Inclusive Environment: A workplace that encourages collaboration. e9fb782f7d3aef3b.description: About the Role Qiddiya | القدية is seeking a Senior Manager Performance Improvement & Value Creation to drive operational performance, efficiency, and value creation across City Operations. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves identifying revenue opportunities, improving productivity, supporting performance management, and providing robust inputs to annual and multi-year planning. The Senior Manager will act as an internal advisor to City Operations functions, translating operational data and business insights into practical initiatives with measurable financial and operational outcomes. Value Creation and Revenue Optimization Identify, assess, and prioritize revenue opportunities across City Operations, including Operations & Maintenance, Fire & Life Safety, Medical Operations, Command & Control, Health, Safety & Environment, Technology, and Events Operations. Develop business cases supported by the Finance department on financial models to evaluate commercial opportunities, cost-recovery mechanisms, pricing options, and operational sustainability. Partner with operational functions and relevant corporate teams to shape opportunities, validate assumptions, define ownership, and support implementation. Benchmark commercial and operating practices against relevant city, infrastructure, utility, real estate, transport, and public-sector operators. Operational Efficiency and Continuous Improvement Identify efficiency opportunities through process optimization, service redesign, productivity improvement, demand and capacity analysis, automation, sourcing, and better use of assets and technology. Conduct structured diagnostic and root-cause analysis to understand cost, quality, productivity, and service-performance gaps. Build an integrated pipeline of improvement initiatives, including quantified benefits, delivery milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, and risks. Coordinate benefit tracking with relevant functions to ensure that approved savings and improvements are implemented, measured, and sustained. Performance Management and Strategic Support Coordinate with the Performance Management function to define and refine KPIs, targets, service levels, and performance measures for City Operations. Support in the analysis of performance trends and variances, identify root causes of underperformance, and recommend targeted corrective actions. Support executive performance reviews by translating operational data into clear insights, decisions, and actions. Follow up on agreed corrective actions and assess whether they are delivering the intended operational and financial results. Coordinate with the Operational Planning function to provide analytical inputs to annual and multi-year planning cycles. Provide evidence-based inputs for workforce planning, budgets, contracts, operational priorities, and strategic initiatives. Support the development of improvement roadmaps aligned with City Operations priorities and Qiddiya-wide objectives. Stakeholder Engagement and Governance Build trusted working relationships across City Operations and relevant enabling functions, facilitating fact-based and constructive challenge. Prepare concise executive materials that clearly articulate the opportunity, evidence, financial impact, implementation requirements, risks, and decisions required. Establish appropriate governance for value-creation and efficiency initiatives, including a consistent approach to prioritization, approvals, tracking, and reporting. Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, commercial awareness, and data-led decision-making. e9c4c72a9e3a4911.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a Project Risk Section Head to join their team in Riyadh. e98cbb72887b250b.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Project Controls & Reporting Associate Director to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves providing strategic leadership and oversight for project controls, planning, schedule assurance, business intelligence, and reporting activities on large and complex construction projects during the construction phase. Role Purpose The Associate Director will ensure that project performance is effectively planned, monitored, analyzed, and reported in alignment with approved schedules, budgets, milestones, contractual requirements, and project objectives. This position requires coordination with project directors, planning and project controls teams, contractors, consultants, commercial and cost teams, construction managers, and client representatives. The role provides senior leadership for project controls, planning, business intelligence, and reporting, ensuring accurate monitoring and reporting of project performance, risks, delays, changes, costs, and key delivery issues to support informed decision-making and successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Lead project controls, planning, reporting, and performance management activities. Oversee the development and management of the master program schedule. Ensure schedule quality, logic, progress measurement, critical path analysis, and baseline control. Monitor planned versus actual progress, milestones, delays, risks, and performance trends. Review contractor and consultant schedules, progress updates, recovery plans, and performance reports. Provide early warnings and recommendations regarding schedule, cost, risk, and delivery issues. Oversee the preparation of weekly, monthly, and executive progress reports. Develop business intelligence dashboards, performance indicators, trend reports, and management presentations. Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and timely submission of project data and reports. Integrate information from schedule, cost, risk, change, procurement, commercial, quality, and construction teams. Review the impact of changes, variations, design development, procurement delays, and construction issues. Oversee delay analysis, time impact assessments, recovery plans, and mitigation strategies. Monitor contractor and consultant performance against approved programs and contractual obligations. Lead project performance review meetings and present key issues to senior management. Maintain project control systems, dashboards, registers, and reporting procedures. Provide leadership, direction, and mentoring to planning, reporting, and project controls teams. Support management decision-making through accurate analysis, forecasting, and performance recommendations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in project controls and reporting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Parsons' Mobility division.

e960bca972992918.description: About Exequt Exequt is a consulting firm specializing in customized solutions for enterprise applications and digital platforms. The company focuses on transparency, collaboration, and addressing core business challenges through structured, agile development processes. Exequt partners with clients from ideation to deployment to deliver long-term value and streamline user experiences. The Role of ETL Engineer Exequt is seeking an ETL Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines for analytics and data platform initiatives. This full-time position, based in Riyadh, involves end-to-end ownership of ETL workflows, from extraction strategy to transformation logic, monitoring, and optimization within a big data stack. The role requires collaboration with business teams to translate requirements into functional pipelines and includes delivery on international projects, particularly in Saudi Arabia. English will be the primary working language for documentation, progress updates, and client-facing solution presentations. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, optimize, and maintain the full ETL lifecycle. Define data extraction strategies, cleansing rules, and transformation logic based on business requirements. Write complex SQL for querying, statistical analysis, and query optimization to enhance processing efficiency. Build and automate ETL workflows using Python, Java, and Shell scripting. Contribute to the design, modeling, and maintenance of Hive-based data warehouses, applying layering concepts (ODS, DWD, DWS, ADS) and optimizing storage structures. Integrate and maintain Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and related big data technologies within ETL workflows. Monitor ETL jobs, configure alerts, troubleshoot failures, and resolve data latency and consistency issues. Establish and continuously improve ETL operations and maintenance standards. Partner with business teams on requirement analysis, solution design, implementation, data validation, and data quality initiatives. Stay current with new tools and techniques and integrate them into the pipeline. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. The role requires proficiency in SQL, Python, Java, and Shell scripting, along with experience in big data technologies such as Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, and Hive. Compensation and Work Environment This position offers a strong, performance-based commission structure. The work environment at Exequt is collaborative and growth-oriented, supporting long-term career progression. The role provides exposure to high-impact projects with leading clients across the Saudi market.

e9b5f8ff6e7aeea3.description: About the Role Aramco Digital is seeking a Legal Expert to join its team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role involves acting as a senior trusted advisor and subject matter expert on complex, high-value technology and telecommunications matters. The Legal Expert provides strategic, commercially driven legal counsel across the full lifecycle of digital and connectivity initiatives, supporting business growth, risk management, and innovation. Role Context and Impact Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Legal Expert leads sophisticated transactions, shapes legal structures for emerging technologies, and plays a key role in governance, regulatory positioning, and stakeholder decision-making across Aramco Digital and its affiliates. The role focuses on translating legal and regulatory requirements into practical, commercially viable solutions while anticipating legal risks and developing mitigation strategies aligned with business objectives. Key Responsibilities Provide proactive, business-oriented legal advice on complex technology, digital infrastructure, and telecommunications matters. Act as a strategic advisor to senior leadership and business units, supporting decision-making on high-impact initiatives. Lead the structuring, drafting, review, and negotiation of complex, high-value, and often cross-border agreements, including SaaS, cloud, digital platform, telecommunications, strategic alliances, technology licensing, and managed services agreements. Act as the lead legal negotiator on critical deals, balancing risk, speed, and commercial outcomes. Structure innovative legal models for emerging technologies such as AI, IoT, edge computing, and data platforms. Provide expert legal support on Artificial Intelligence (AI) model governance, liability allocation, ethical frameworks, Industrial IoT, smart infrastructure, cloud computing, data localization, cybersecurity, and telecommunications regulation. Identify and assess data privacy, cross-border data transfer, export control, and digital sovereignty risks. Interpret evolving regulatory landscapes and advise on compliance strategies in KSA and international jurisdictions. Design, review, and enhance internal legal policies, templates, and governance frameworks. Provide legal support on corporate governance matters, including board and committee materials, shareholder-related matters, and governance structures for subsidiaries and joint ventures. Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and internal control frameworks, and support enterprise risk management initiatives. Lead the assessment and resolution of complex claims and disputes arising from commercial and technology agreements, including supporting dispute strategy and settlement negotiations. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Law (LLB or equivalent) is required. A postgraduate qualification (LLM or equivalent) is strongly preferred. Candidates must be currently licensed, admitted to practice, and in good standing in a common law jurisdiction (*, United Kingdom or United States). Experience: 8-12 years of experience in a leading TMT-focused law firm and/or a large technology or telecommunications organization. Expertise: Extensive experience advising on complex, high-value technology and telecom transactions. Strong track record in leading negotiations and structuring strategic commercial agreements. Demonstrated expertise in AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, industrial IoT, and connectivity solutions. Proven experience in corporate governance and board advisory matters. Preferred: Experience working in multi-jurisdictional and cross-border environments is highly preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Location The role is based in Dhahran, Eastern region.

e9e2d84476989f3e.description: About Applus+ Applus+ is a global leader in inspection, testing, and certification services, delivering innovative solutions across key industries including energy, construction, environment, and infrastructure. Operating in more than 70 countries, we are committed to helping clients achieve operational excellence while maintaining the highest safety and environmental standards. At Applus+, we foster a culture of integrity, technical leadership, and continuous professional development. Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia Role Summary The Mechanical Engineer will oversee the operation, maintenance, and performance of mechanical equipment and fleet used in waste management operations. The role focuses on equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, operational efficiency, and compliance with technical and HSE requirements. Key Responsibilities Supervise the operation and maintenance of equipment and machinery used in waste collection, transportation, construction and demolition (C&D) waste management, and landfill projects, including collection vehicles, compactors, dump trucks, containers, cranes, and operational equipment at transfer and treatment stations as well as worker accommodation camps. Review and evaluate preventive and corrective maintenance plans, ensuring their implementation in compliance with technical and environmental standards. Monitor the performance of equipment and treatment stations, review breakdown and repair reports to ensure operational continuity and the efficiency of waste disposal systems. Conduct benchmarking and analytical studies to assess equipment performance and the quality of operations and maintenance across project facilities. Follow up on the application of manufacturers’ instructions and technical specifications for field and landfill equipment, ensuring compliance with environmental safety requirements. Review periodic maintenance schedules and fleet management plans, and provide technical recommendations to enhance operational efficiency and minimize recurrent breakdowns. Prepare technical analytical reports highlighting improvement observations related to equipment performance, failures, and system functionality in both field and landfill operations. Supervise field maintenance activities and ensure strict adherence to occupational safety and quality standards (HSE) in workshops, operational sites, and landfill areas.
